remarks: Enjoy coastal living in this beautifully proportioned townhouse, ideally located in sought-after Marina Bay. The thoughtfully designed main level features a galley kitchen, a formal dining room with balcony, and a generous living room with a cozy fireplace and convenient half bath. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite offers a private deck, a full en-suite bath, and a custom walk-in closet. The second bedroom is equally spacious and includes its own private bath. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, reserved parking (Spot #41), and ample guest parking. Marina Bay residents enjoy access to a clubhouse and pool overlooking Long Island Sound, creating a true resort-like setting. Conveniently located near beaches, shopping, and vibrant downtown Stamford, this home is perfect for commuters and those seeking both comfort and tranquility. Offering tremendous potential for your personal updates and finishing touches, this home is attractively priced, a fantastic opportunity and a wonderful place to live
